mapper.subject: Welcome to I Supply Chain — let's get started
mapper.body:
Hi {{1.body.data.name}},

Thank you for reaching out to I Supply Chain. We've reviewed your submission and we're excited to help you optimise your supply chain.

Over the next few days we'll send you some useful resources and would love to schedule a short discovery call at your convenience.

→ Book a 20-minute discovery call

If you have any questions in the meantime, simply reply to this email.


Best regards,
The I Supply Chain Team

I Supply Chain — YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN

setupSteps: 1. In Make.com, create a new scenario and import this JSON (three dots → Import Blueprint).
2. Click the Webhook module and copy the generated webhook URL.
3. In ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks, create a webhook with event 'lead.captured' and paste that URL.
4. Add your Gmail connection to all Gmail modules.
6. The Delay module waits 48 hours before the follow-up — adjust if needed.
7. Note: lead fields (name, email, company, industry) are nested under data in the payload — the template already uses the correct paths (1.body.data.name, 1.body.data.email).
